evals.name: loads-only-the-named-surfaces
evals.prompt: The accepted contract is: the settings page's save button must show a pending state while the form submits, and must not shift layout when it does. Implement it.
evals.expected_output: The pass names the surfaces the contract actually touches, loads only the skills that own them, and records the rest as not applicable rather than loading the whole index.
assertions: Names the surfaces before naming any skill
Loads ui-design-language for the pending state's visual treatment and transitions-dev for the motion
Does NOT load next-best-practices, ai-elements, or migrate-radix-to-base for a contract that touches none of them
Records skills not loaded as not applicable rather than silently omitting them

evals.name: project-system-outranks-the-index
evals.prompt: This repository already has a design system: a tokens file, a themed component library, and a CLAUDE.md describing its visual language. Implement a new empty state for the reports list.
evals.expected_output: The project's own system supplies the answer; the indexed design skill fills only what the project left undefined.
assertions: Reads the repository's tokens, theme and component conventions before loading any indexed skill
Does NOT overwrite an existing visual identity with the indexed design language
Records that precedence level 2 supplied the answer
Uses the indexed skill only for gaps the project does not define

evals.name: charts-load-dataviz-first
evals.prompt: Add a panel to the dashboard showing weekly active users over the last quarter, with a comparison against the previous quarter.
evals.expected_output: dataviz is loaded before any chart code exists, ahead of the frontend index, and the visual system skill themes the result rather than choosing the chart form.
assertions: Loads dataviz before writing the first line of chart code
Does NOT let ui-design-language or shadcn decide the chart form
Still loads the visual system for the panel's surrounding surface

evals.name: absent-skill-is-owed-not-substituted
evals.prompt: Implement a redesigned pricing page. The transitions-dev skill is not installed in this environment.
evals.expected_output: The missing skill is recorded as unavailable with its coverage owed, and the pass proceeds on the surfaces it can cover.
assertions: Records transitions-dev as unavailable with a reason
Does NOT improvise motion guidance in place of the missing skill
Does NOT block the surfaces it can still cover
Names the owed coverage in the stage receipt so a later gate can see it

evals.name: does-not-restate-what-it-indexes
evals.prompt: What spacing scale and corner radius should this card use?
evals.expected_output: The answer comes from the indexed design skill, not from this one; this skill routes and stops.
assertions: Routes the question to ui-design-language rather than answering it
Does NOT state spacing, radius, color or motion values of its own
Contains no design guidance that would go stale when the indexed skill updates
